company_profile.name: Mahad Impex
company_profile.type: Direct textile buying house & sourcing management
company_profile.specialization: Connecting overseas distributors and wholesale brands directly with audited Pakistani mills for premium home textiles
key_strengths: Direct mill-gate FOB pricing with zero trading company markups
On-site 4-stage quality control (raw yarn, in-line weaving, dyeing/printing, final AQL 2.5 packing)
Fast sampling: 4-day lab dips and 7-day custom pre-production strike-offs
Flexible commercial MOQs starting from 500 pieces per colorway
Full export logistics management, container consolidation, and customs documentation
why_pakistan: World's 3rd largest bed linen exporter and #1 terry towel producer
Abundant domestic long-staple cotton offering superior tensile strength and hand-feel
Significant tariff and cost advantage over regional competitors
Established vertically integrated mills with decades of global export compliance

munir.focus: FOB Pricing, Margin Protection, Mill-Direct Economics

angles.name: mill_gate_margin
angles.theme: Cutting out middleman trading markups to improve buyer gross margins
angles.hook_instruction: Mention reaching out directly from Faisalabad where we work at the mill gate, typically cutting 12-18% off landed FOB costs compared to European/US trading intermediaries.
angles.cta: Can I send over our current Q3/Q4 FOB rate card for you to compare against your existing landed costs?

angles.name: cotton_price_stabilization
angles.theme: Current cotton price window to lock in advantageous contract pricing
angles.hook_instruction: Highlight that raw cotton prices in South Asia have stabilized, making this the ideal quarter for wholesale distributors to benchmark their upcoming replenishment rates.
angles.cta: Would you be open to reviewing a quick FOB benchmark quote on your primary volume lines?

angles.name: supply_chain_diversification
angles.theme: Adding a competitive, reliable Pakistani mill partner to balance supply risks
angles.hook_instruction: Notice they distribute high-volume textile lines and mention how we help overseas importers establish direct, reliable mill allocations without broker friction.
angles.cta: Worth sending across our 2026 FOB price sheet, or are you completely locked in with existing suppliers right now?

angles.name: direct_volume_capacity
angles.theme: High-volume container replenishment with on-time delivery guarantees
angles.hook_instruction: Reference our network of audited composite mills in Faisalabad capable of handling steady 20ft/40ft container programs with predictable 25-35 day lead times.
angles.cta: Can I share our FOB price comparison and container lead-time schedule for your procurement team?

aliyan.focus: Fabric Quality, Yarn Specs, Quality Inspection, Physical Swatches

angles.name: fabric_swatch_offer
angles.theme: Sending free physical fabric swatch cards directly to their office
angles.hook_instruction: Mention you oversee product development and quality on the ground in Faisalabad, working with combed cotton weaves (200TC to 600TC percales/sateens) and plush ring-spun terry (450-650 GSM).
angles.cta: Can I mail a free physical swatch book with our current fabric constructions directly to your desk?

angles.name: on_site_quality_control
angles.theme: Eliminating delivery surprises through 4-stage on-site mill inspections
angles.hook_instruction: Explain that unlike overseas agents who only inspect finished goods, our on-ground team tests yarn count, verifies weaving density, and runs AQL 2.5 final inspections before containers seal.
angles.cta: Would it be helpful if I sent over a sample inspection report and spec sheet for review?

angles.name: rapid_custom_sampling
angles.theme: Low MOQ custom sampling and fast lab dip turnarounds
angles.hook_instruction: Highlight our agile sample development: 4-day lab dips and 7-day custom strike-offs with flexible trial MOQs from 500 pcs per style.
angles.cta: Are you developing any new specs or colorways for upcoming seasons that you'd like us to develop a quick sample for?

angles.name: certified_mill_allocation
angles.theme: Strict OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS, and social compliance
angles.hook_instruction: Highlight that all our manufacturing partners in Faisalabad are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 and BSCI/Sedex certified, ensuring clean European and US retail compliance.
angles.cta: Would you like me to share our certified mill portfolio and fabric spec guide?
